items.title: 29.5.1 Infrared spectra samajhna aur andaza lagana (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of interpreting IR spectra (PDF 193).

blocks.text: IR spectra samajhna seekhne ka behtareen tareeqa hal shuda misalein parhna aur spectrum ki khaas khasiyaton se waqif hona hai.

blocks.title: Misal 29.1
blocks.text: Do spectra propan-2-ol aur propanone ke hain. Taqreeban 1710 cm-1 par tez, nokeeli absorption C=O (carbonyl) group dikhati hai, jo ketone ka functional group hai, is liye spectrum A propanone hai. Spectrum B mein taqreeban 3200-3600 cm-1 par tez absorption alcohol ka -OH group dikhati hai, is liye B propan-2-ol hai.

blocks.alt: Do infrared spectra, A (oopar) aur B (neeche), dono absorbance / % (oopar 0, neeche 100) aur wavenumber/cm^-1 (4000 se 500) par. A mein 3450 ke qareeb chhota jhukao, 3000 ke qareeb tez band aur 1750 ke qareeb bohat tez, nokeela band, phir 1500 se neeche kai bands. B mein 3350 ke qareeb bohat chaura, gehra band, 2950 ke qareeb tez bands aur 1500 se neeche bohat se bands.
blocks.caption: Misal 29.1: infrared spectra A aur B (Misal 29.1 ke saath chhape spectra ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Kisi compound ke IR spectrum mein 1715 cm-1 par tez, nokeela band hai aur 3200 aur 3600 cm-1 ke darmiyan koi band nahi. Yeh ghaliban butanone hai ya butan-2-ol?
blocks.explanation: Butanone: 1715 cm-1 ka band C=O stretch hai, aur chaure O-H band ki ghair maujoodgi alcohol ko radd karti hai.

items: Taqreeban 1700-1750 cm-1 par C=O (nokeela): carbonyl compounds.
